subject: general
question: Who is the 52nd Chief Justice of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice BR Gavai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai was sworn in as the 52nd Chief Justice of India on 14 May 2025. 
 
• He succeeded Justice Sanjiv Khanna and will serve until 23 November 2025. 
 
• Gavai is the first Buddhist and the second Dalit judge to hold the CJI post.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Justice NV Ramana**

 
 
• Served as the 48th Chief Justice of India, taking oath in 2021. 
 
• Known for efforts to modernize court procedures and reduce backlog.
 
 
 
• **Justice DY Chandrachud**
 
 
• Served as the 50th Chief Justice of India from November 2022 to November 2024. 
 
• He played a key role in several landmark constitutional rulings.
 
 
 
• **Justice Sanjiv Khanna**
 
 
• Was the 51st Chief Justice of India from 11 November 2024 to 13 May 2025. 
 
• Preceded Justice BR Gavai in the CJI succession list.
